text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: From 14.0 s the car begins to drift sideways and slightly rotate on the pale shelf next to the water, then at 14.8 s the camera has moved and the car sits lower right. The car stays on pale ledge strips and never visibly sinks or leaves the bank in these samples.
